mandatoryCriteria: Project trash list: GET /api/v1/projects/:projectId/trash returns trashed cards in the project for owner/manager
Non-administrator privacy: Non-administrators (members/viewers) receive 403 FORBIDDEN on trash listing
Trash row details: Returns id, title, deletedAt, deletedBy, restoreUntil, canRestore, blockedReason, serverNow
scopeAndExclusions: In-scope: Project trash query for administrators.
